findings.failure_path: The immediately preceding version already wrote run.session_files, while accepting a non-empty regular file named only <session>. Such a record contains transcripts: ["transcript-<UUID>"] and session_files: []. The new list-presence guard accepts it, regrade passes the old transcripts unchanged to make_record, and list truthiness again satisfies persistence validity. An otherwise successful sample without any <session>.jsonl transcript therefore remains valid after regrading with this fix. The new legacy regression deletes session_files, so it does not exercise this actual predecessor format.
findings.smallest_fix: Version the corrected classification and refuse records from earlier classifiers, or revalidate their saved artifacts against the exact filename, type and size requirements. Add a regression retaining session_files: [] alongside a previously accepted bare-session transcript.
